title: hOUR Chain Settlement Receipt payload
description: Content-addressed payload of a settlement receipt event (SPEC.md 'Settlement receipt'; ADR-0009 section 4). Emitted by the adapter for one leg after reconciliation. Links the network's receipt to the instruction, with finality status. Receipts are never edited: a reversal or dispute is a new event.

settlementId.description: hst1_ + first 40 hex chars of sha256(instructionEventId + ':' + legIndex) (ADR-0009 section 2).

networkTxRef.description: Network transaction reference, for example the GCUL transaction hash.

contractId.description: Settlement contract that recorded the receipt, for example a GCUL 1:CTR:... ID.

finality.description: final: reconciled and settled. reversed: superseded by a reversing instruction. disputed: reconciliation mismatch under review.

networkRound.description: Network round or block in which the transaction finalized, when the network reports one.

reconciliationRunId.description: Reconciliation run that checked this leg against the instruction and the ledger.
